item.title: github: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
item.description:
HydraFusion now has an updated model pool and improved orchestration workflows. A new HydraFusion Max option is also available, with both offerings supported in VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app, and GitHub Copilot.

  • Source: GitHub
